fullText.simplified:
四、珍珠泪

    柳毅回到洞庭，去洞庭湖的南岸找龙女说的那棵常年绿色的柳树。
    这时候已经是冬天了，天气特别冷，他冻得发抖。湖边的树叶也都变黄了，但有棵柳树还是绿色的。柳毅知道就是这棵了。他走过去在树根处敲了九下。一会儿后，湖里水浪翻滚，一个武士出现在湖面上。
    “请问您是从哪儿来的贵客？”武士向柳毅行礼问。
    “我叫柳毅，刚从泾阳回来，要见龙王。”
    武士想了想，把湖水分开，湖底出现一条道路，一直通向湖心深处。
    “请跟我来。”武士说。
    柳毅跟着武士，走在湖底的道路上。每走一步，身后被分开的湖水就回来一步。等走到湖心，身后的道路就不见了，湖水全都回来了。
    湖心有几座高楼，楼前种着许多漂亮的花和树，都是柳毅没见过的。柳毅知道，这就是洞庭湖底的龙宫了。武士带着柳毅走进了最高的那座楼，楼内漂亮极了。
    “请您在这里等一下。龙王等会儿就会来见您。”武士说。
    柳毅坐着等了一会儿，一个穿红色衣服的老人出来了。他的衣服贵气，样子高大。柳毅心想，这应该就是洞庭湖的龙王了。
    龙王看了柳毅一眼，有点儿吃惊：“你只是个普通的人类，怎么知道来龙宫的方法？”
    柳毅说：“是您的这位武士带我来的。”
    “我是问，你怎么知道在那棵常绿的柳树下敲九下的？”
    柳毅明白过来，连忙说：“是您的女儿龙女姑娘告诉我的。”
    龙王很意外，“龙儿？她什么时候告诉你的？你见过她了？在哪儿见的？”
    “两个月前我在泾阳见到了龙女姑娘，当时她在放羊，她跟我说……”
    “放羊？龙儿在放羊？我的宝贝在放羊？怎么可能？泾河龙王怎么会让龙儿去放羊？你不要胡说！”龙王看起来很生气，声音也大了不少。
    “我没有胡说。”柳毅从衣服里拿出龙女送给他的那颗珍珠，“这是……”柳毅的话还没说完，手中的珍珠就自己飞了起来。
    珍珠飞到龙王面前，龙王吃惊地伸手接住了。珍珠在龙王的手里发出明亮的光，亮得让柳毅的眼睛都不舒服了。大概有五分钟，光亮终于没有了，珍珠变回一滴眼泪，落在了龙王的手心里。
    柳毅看到龙王的脸变得通红了，不知道是因为无法忍受的难过还是生气。
    “泾河龙王！你怎么敢这么对待我的女儿！”龙王大叫。
fullText.traditional:
四、珍珠淚

    柳毅回到洞庭，去洞庭湖的南岸找龍女說的那棵常年綠色的柳樹。
    這時候已經是冬天了，天氣特別冷，他凍得發抖。湖邊的樹葉也都變黃了，但有棵柳樹還是綠色的。柳毅知道就是這棵了。他走過去在樹根處敲了九下。一會兒後，湖裡水浪翻滾，一個武士出現在湖面上。
    “請問您是從哪兒來的貴客？”武士向柳毅行禮問。
    “我叫柳毅，剛從涇陽回來，要見龍王。”
    武士想了想，把湖水分開，湖底出現一條道路，一直通向湖心深處。
    “請跟我來。”武士說。
    柳毅跟著武士，走在湖底的道路上。每走一步，身後被分開的湖水就回來一步。等走到湖心，身後的道路就不見了，湖水全都回來了。
    湖心有幾座高樓，樓前種著許多漂亮的花和樹，都是柳毅沒見過的。柳毅知道，這就是洞庭湖底的龍宮了。武士帶著柳毅走進了最高的那座樓，樓內漂亮極了。
    “請您在這裡等一下。龍王等會兒就會來見您。”武士說。
    柳毅坐著等了一會兒，一個穿紅色衣服的老人出來了。他的衣服貴氣，樣子高大。柳毅心想，這應該就是洞庭湖的龍王了。
    龍王看了柳毅一眼，有點兒吃驚：“你只是個普通的人類，怎麼知道來龍宮的方法？”
    柳毅說：“是您的這位武士帶我來的。”
    “我是問，你怎麼知道在那棵常綠的柳樹下敲九下的？”
    柳毅明白過來，連忙說：“是您的女兒龍女姑娘告訴我的。”
    龍王很意外，“龍兒？她什麼時候告訴你的？你見過她了？在哪兒見的？”
    “兩個月前我在涇陽見到了龍女姑娘，當時她在放羊，她跟我說……”
    “放羊？龍兒在放羊？我的寶貝在放羊？怎麼可能？涇河龍王怎麼會讓龍兒去放羊？你不要胡說！”龍王看起來很生氣，聲音也大了不少。
    “我沒有胡說。”柳毅從衣服裡拿出龍女送給他的那顆珍珠，“這是……”柳毅的話還沒說完，手中的珍珠就自己飛了起來。
    珍珠飛到龍王面前，龍王吃驚地伸手接住了。珍珠在龍王的手裡發出明亮的光，亮得讓柳毅的眼睛都不舒服了。大概有五分鐘，光亮終於沒有了，珍珠變回一滴眼淚，落在了龍王的手心裡。
    柳毅看到龍王的臉變得通紅了，不知道是因為無法忍受的難過還是生氣。
    “涇河龍王！你怎麼敢這麼對待我的女兒！”龍王大叫。

sentences.english: The pearl flew in front of the Dragon King. The Dragon King, in surprise, reached out his hand to catch it.

sentences.simplified: 珍珠在龙王的手里发出明亮的光，亮得让柳毅的眼睛都不舒服了。
sentences.traditional: 珍珠在龍王的手裡發出明亮的光，亮得讓柳毅的眼睛都不舒服了。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn zhū zài lóng wáng de shǒu lǐ fā chū míng liàng de guāng liàng de ràng liǔ yì de yǎn jing dōu bù shū fu le
sentences.english: The pearl in the Dragon King’s hand emitted a bright light, so bright that it made Liu Yi’s eyes uncomfortable.

sentences.simplified: 大概有五分钟，光亮终于没有了，珍珠变回一滴眼泪，落在了龙王的手心里。
sentences.traditional: 大概有五分鐘，光亮終於沒有了，珍珠變回一滴眼淚，落在了龍王的手心裡。
sentences.pinyin: dà gài yǒu wǔ fēn zhōng guāng liàng zhōng yú méi yǒu le zhēn zhū biàn huí yì dī yǎn lèi luò zài le lóng wáng de shǒu xīn lǐ
sentences.english: After about five minutes, the light was finally gone.  The pearl turned back into a teardrop and fell into the Dragon King’s palm.

sentences.simplified: 柳毅看到龙王的脸变得通红了，不知道是因为无法忍受的难过还是生气。
sentences.traditional: 柳毅看到龍王的臉變得通紅了，不知道是因為無法忍受的難過還是生氣。
sentences.pinyin: liǔ yì kàn dào lóng wáng de liǎn biàn de tōng hóng le bù zhī dào shì yīn wèi wú fǎ rěn shòu de nán guò hái shi shēng qì
sentences.english: Liu Yi saw the Dragon King’s face turn bright red. He didn’t know whether it was due to unbearable sadness or anger.

sentences.simplified: “泾河龙王！你怎么敢这么对待我的女儿！”龙王大叫。
sentences.traditional: “涇河龍王！你怎麼敢這麼對待我的女兒！”龍王大叫。
sentences.pinyin: jīng hé lóng wáng nǐ zěn me gǎn zhè me duì dài wǒ de nǚ ér lóng wáng dà jiào
sentences.english: “Dragon King of the Jing River! How dare you treat my daughter like this!” the Dragon King shouted.

sentence_translations: 4. Pearl Tear
Liu Yi returned to Dongting and went to the southern shore of Dongting Lake to find the evergreen willow tree Longnü had mentioned.
It was already winter by this time. The weather was particularly cold, so cold that he was shivering.
The leaves by the lake had all turned yellow, but there was one willow tree that was still green.
Liu Yi knew that this was the one. He walked over and knocked nine times on its roots.
After a while, the lake’s waters churned, and a palace guard appeared on the surface of the lake.
“May I ask where you, esteemed guest, have come from?” the palace guard saluted Liu Yi and asked.
“My name is Liu Yi. I have just returned from Jingyang and wish to see the Dragon King.”
The palace guard thought for a moment, then parted the lake’s waters, ..
.. revealing a path on the lakebed that led deep into the center of the lake.
“Please follow me,” the palace guard said.
Liu Yi followed the palace guard, walking along the path on the lakebed.
With each step he took, the parted lake waters closed back behind him.
By the time he reached the center of the lake, the path behind him had disappeared, and the waters had fully returned.
At the center of the lake stood several tall buildings.
Many beautiful flowers and trees were planted in front of the buildings, all of which Liu Yi had never seen before.
Liu Yi knew that this was the Dragon Palace at the bottom of Dongting Lake.
The palace guard led Liu Yi into the tallest building, which was extremely beautiful inside.
“Please wait here for a moment. The Dragon King will come to see you shortly,” the palace guard said.
Liu Yi sat and waited for a while, and then an old man dressed in red came out.
His clothes were elegant, and he looked tall and imposing.
Liu Yi thought to himself, this must be the Dragon King of Dongting Lake.
The Dragon King glanced at Liu Yi, somewhat surprised:
“You’re just an ordinary human. How did you know how to get to the Dragon Palace?”
Liu Yi said, “It was your palace guard who brought me here.”
“I am asking, how did you know to knock nine times under the evergreen willow tree?”
Liu Yi understood and quickly said, “It was your daughter, Miss Longnü, who told me.”
The Dragon King was very surprised: “Long’er? When did she tell you? Have you met her? Where did you see her?”
“I met Miss Longnü in Jingyang two months ago. At that time, she was tending sheep, and she told me …”
“Tending sheep? Long’er was tending sheep? My precious was tending sheep?
How is that possible? Why would the Dragon King of the Jing River have Long’er tend sheep? Don’t talk nonsense!”
The Dragon King looked very angry, and his voice also grew much louder.
“I am not talking nonsense.”
Liu Yi took out the pearl that Longnü had given him from his clothes.
“This is …” Before Liu Yi could finish his words, the pearl in his hand began to float by itself.
The pearl flew in front of the Dragon King. The Dragon King, in surprise, reached out his hand to catch it.
The pearl in the Dragon King’s hand emitted a bright light, so bright that it made Liu Yi’s eyes uncomfortable.
After about five minutes, the light was finally gone.  The pearl turned back into a teardrop and fell into the Dragon King’s palm.
Liu Yi saw the Dragon King’s face turn bright red. He didn’t know whether it was due to unbearable sadness or anger.
“Dragon King of the Jing River! How dare you treat my daughter like this!” the Dragon King shouted.
